# Upstream workflow archive

Unmodified workflows from Orca v1.4.235 are retained here for reference and attribution. This directory is not executed by GitHub Actions. They depend on upstream runner fleets, cloud infrastructure, secrets and release channels; enabling them wholesale would not produce a usable fork CI.

Active fork checks live in `../workflows/pr.yml`. Installers, signing, deployment and automatic updates are intentionally excluded until the fork has an independent application identity and delivery channel.
